plan_ref: planning/steward-chamber-2026-08-09/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md :: Wave 4 (F2 versioned manifest schema; C2 typed edges + declared deliverable; E9 distinct stages)
law: The chamber-owned sidecar pipeline manifest is a VERSIONED, JSON-schema'd document (F2): two developers (or Foreman waves) derive identical manifests from THIS schema, never from prose braces. Schema evolution is an explicit versioned change: bump schema_version, append a migration note below, keep the prior version readable. The manifest lives in the project's chamber sidecar (.anchor/chamber/pipeline-manifest.json) — chamber-owned derived data; the engine spine (roadmap_events, receipts, reflection payloads) is never touched by manifest machinery.

migration_notes.note: Initial schema (steward-chamber W4, 2026-08-09): scaffold key, steps with per-step yield contracts {shape, report_link} and E9-distinct verification stages, typed edges {from, to, artifact_kind}, honest declared-deliverable ({declared:false} when none is declared — never fabricated). Future migrations: bump schema_version, append a note here, and teach chamber_manifest.validate_manifest the prior version explicitly.

e9_law: Reflection and delta verification are DISTINCT scaffold stages (E9): every step's stages list carries BOTH exact tokens, and a single collapsed token standing in for both is refused by the lint — layered verification holds at the data layer.
